cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Merciful Lie
cards.instruction: Choose a truth your character believes would hurt someone. Keep it from them, even as honesty becomes harder.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't call this a rejected poem. The magazine has the wrong format for it; we need a booklet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: If you think it's bad too, I'll stop writing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You are confusing format with quality. I'll write the cover description: 'A voice that deserves more space.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Put 'recommended by' and your name above it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Below the description, in smaller type. Please send me the proof; I would like my name to be the one thing they cannot criticise.
